suggestedAction: Install or activate Node.js v22.12.0 or newer (see plugin package.json engines) before running hybrid-memory maintenance.
Retry once after a short backoff; if it repeats, reduce concurrency or move the job to a lower-traffic window.
Retry once; if it repeats, check gateway health and WebSocket/RPC availability.

Verify provider credentials and endpoint configuration before retrying embedding or LLM work. After auth is fixed, `analyze-maintenance-logs --auto-fix --auto-fix-all` can run `hybrid-mem reembed-vectorless --limit 200 --apply` once for this batch.
Free disk space or expand storage immediately, then rerun failed maintenance.

Retry once; if it persists, schedule VACUUM/vector optimization during an idle window. With persisted history, `analyze-maintenance-logs --auto-fix --auto-fix-all` can run VACUUM + `hybrid-mem vectordb-optimize` after repeated SQLITE_BUSY in a 24h window.
Report to GlitchTip with fingerprint and inspect the stack trace for a plugin regression.
Record as smoke timeout; do not escalate unless it repeats.
Report to GlitchTip and inspect cron agent orchestration; this can hide real maintenance failures.
Report to GlitchTip and recreate/repair the guard only after confirming the job actually succeeded.
Another run may be holding a scan lock; if the PID is stale, clear the lock file after confirming no live process.
